about_short_description.short_description: Nototo is a spatial workspace that allows you to take notes, organize wiki, and track tasks collaboratively on a single canvas.

product.name: Spatial Workspace
product.description: A platform for organizing notes, wikis, and tasks on a visual canvas, allowing for collaborative work in real time.

product.name: Text Editor
product.description: A feature-rich text editor designed to support the thought process and facilitate note-taking.

product.name: Kanban View
product.description: A tool within the workspace for managing tasks using the Kanban methodology.

product.name: Calendar View
product.description: A feature for scheduling and tracking tasks and events within the workspace.

product.name: Table View
product.description: Allows users to organize and view data in a tabular format within the workspace.

product.name: Real-time Collaboration
product.description: Enables team members to share workspaces and collaborate in real time.
